title: Expand cos(2x+x) to obtain the triple-angle formula

source.note: 9709/21/O/N/11 Question 8(i) only [5]. Official QP and official MS. Part (ii) omitted.

stem:
This question is 9709/21/O/N/11 Question 8(i) only, taken from the official QP.

(i) By first expanding cos(2x + x), show that

cos 3x ≡ 4 cos³ x − 3 cos x. [5]

steps.name: M1
steps.text_tex: Make relevant use of the \(\cos(A+B)\) formula: \(\cos 3x=\cos(2x+x)=\cos 2x\cos x-\sin 2x\sin x\).
steps.note: Official MS: M1*, make relevant use of the cos(A+B) formula. The D-dependency of a later mark is recorded in that later note.

steps.name: M2
steps.text_tex: Make relevant use of \(\cos 2x=2\cos^2 x-1\) (or an equivalent) and \(\sin 2x=2\sin x\cos x\).
steps.note: Official MS: M1*, make relevant use of the cos 2A and sin 2A formulae.

steps.name: A1
steps.text_tex: A correct expression in terms of \(\cos x\) and \(\sin x\) is obtained, for example \( (2\cos^2 x-1)\cos x-(2\sin x\cos x)\sin x\).
steps.note: Official MS: A1, obtain a correct expression in terms of cos x and sin x.

steps.name: M3
steps.text_tex: Use \(\sin^2 x=1-\cos^2 x\) to obtain an expression in terms of \(\cos x\) only.
steps.note: Official MS: M1(dep*), dependent on the starred method marks. The D prefix is recorded here; the mark field is M1.

steps.name: A2
steps.text_tex: The given answer \(\cos 3x\equiv 4\cos^3 x-3\cos x\) is obtained correctly.
steps.note: Official MS: A1, obtain the given answer correctly. Independent: (2c^2-1)c-2s^2 c=2c^3-c-2(1-c^2)c=2c^3-c-2c+2c^3=4c^3-3c.

contexts.note: Stem taken from the official QP PDF (UCLES 2011), Question 8(i) only. Official MS reproduced mark by mark, including the starred M marks and the dependent M1. Paper/self-mark.
